title: Simbaril's Purpur
body:
This texture changes the looks of Purpur blocks to make them more Simbaril-style. I added a Shulker face to the top side of the Purpur Pillar block because Purpur blocks do not have a chiseled variant. And here is how it looks:
![Pur](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7a947763792e371724040fae13b4f8495570192.jpeg)
and this is how looks, if you go to the end city. Here is it:
![End](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/67b5d26052ecb6b686d586d5d57b78e800a3eef1.jpeg)
It's looks better. Thanks for view, like, and download !!!
